text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 15, 2024) for 2190 Weston Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 15, 2024) for 2190 Weston Road, Folder Number 24 238421 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 5, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
